description: AI-assisted desktop video editor with a manual timeline and local rendering

checkver.script: $request = [System.Net.HttpWebRequest]::Create('https://api.antonvideo.app/v1/releases/download/windows'); $request.Method = 'GET'; $request.AllowAutoRedirect = $false; $request.Timeout = 20000; $request.UserAgent = 'kirobucket-checkver'; try { $response = $request.GetResponse() } catch [System.Net.WebException] { $response = $_.Exception.Response }; if ($null -eq $response) { throw 'Anton release endpoint did not return an HTTP response.' }; $location = [string]$response.Headers['Location']; $response.Close(); $match = [regex]::Match($location, '/v(?<version>\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/Anton-Setup-'); if (-not $match.Success) { throw "Could not extract Anton version from redirect: $location" }; $match.Groups['version'].Value

notes: Review status: the official Windows endpoint currently redirects to an Anton setup executable, but no publisher checksum was available for verification.
This manifest downloads the setup file only. It does not run an unverified installer or claim to manage Anton's installation or removal.
Manual inspection and verification of the setup type, installation path, silent-install behavior, and uninstaller are still required.
